# Wait: block (1,7) TR ray: from TR corner (1,8): step1=(0,9): o[0][9]=6 but input seed there was 6@(0,9)!? earlier seeds list had (0,9,6)? yes. But out (0,9)=6 ✓ so TR ray color... my loop printed 'ray color 0' because o[1][8] is a block cell. Fix: start beyond block edge: for each corner cell of the 2x2 block, outward diag starts one step beyond that corner: TL→(0,6) etc. Recompute ray colors from first free cell outward.
def rays_of(i,o,br,bc,Hh,Ww):
    cs={'TL':(br,bc),'TR':(br,bc+1),'BL':(br+1,bc),'BR':(br+1,bc+1)}
    ds={'TL':(-1,-1),'TR':(-1,1),'BL':(1,-1),'BR':(1,1)}
    out=[]
    for k,(rr,cc) in cs.items():
        dr,dc=ds[k]; col=None; st=0
        for step in range(1,30):
            r,c=rr+dr*step,cc+dc*step
            if not(0<=r<Hh and 0<=c<Ww): break
            v=i[r][c]
            if v==2 or v!=0: st=0; continue
            if col is None: col=v
            elif v!=col: col=None
            st+=1
        out.append((k,col))
    return out
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i,o=G[p+' input'],G[p+' output']
    Hh,Ww=len(i),len(i[0])
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(Hh-1) for c in range(Ww-1) if i[r][c]==2 and i[r][c+1]==2 and i[r+1][c]==2 and i[r+1][c+1]==2]
    print(p)
    for br,bc in blocks:
        print('  ',rays_of(i,o,br,bc,Hh,Ww),'nearby-seeds:',[(r-br,c-bc,i[r][c]) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c] not in (0,2) and abs(r-br)+abs(c-bc)<=4])

def solve(i):
    H=len(i); W=len(i[0])
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if i[r][c]==2 and i[r][c+1]==2 and i[r+1][c]==2 and i[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for br,bc in blocks:
        for r in range(br,br+2):
            for c in range(bc,bc+2):
                out[r][c]=2
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    for r,c in sorted(seeds,key=lambda s:s[0]+s[1]):
        v=i[r][c]
        cr,cc=min(blocks,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-r)+abs(b[1]-c))
        ctr,ctc=cr+0.5,cc+0.5
        dr=r-ctr; dc=c-ctc
        nr=int(round(ctr+dc)); nc=int(round(ctc-dr))
        # ray direction: away from block center along diagonal through (nr,nc)
        sr=-1 if nr<=ctr else 1   # away from center: nr above center -> move up
        sc=-1 if nc<=ctc else 1
        rr,rc=nr,nc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=rc<W and out[rr][rc]!=2:
            out[rr][rc]=v; rr+=sr; rc+=sc
    return out

def solve(i):
    H=len(i); W=len(i[0])
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if i[r][c]==2 and i[r][c+1]==2 and i[r+1][c]==2 and i[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for br,bc in blocks:
        for r in range(br,br+2):
            for c in range(bc,bc+2):
                out[r][c]=2
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # first pass: relocated seeds paint their new pos + ray away from center, but stop before painting a cell another seed will relocate to? Use two-phase: record all rotations & rays, then paint rays only over zeros (seeds' orig cells become 0).
    reloc={}  # old->new
    for r,c in seeds:
        v=i[r][c]
        cr,cc=min(blocks,key=lambda b:abs(b[0]-r)+abs(b[1]-c))
        ctr,ctc=cr+0.5,cc+0.5
        dr=r-ctr; dc=c-ctc
        nr=int(round(ctr+dc)); nc=int(round(ctc-dr))
        sr=-1 if nr<=ctr else 1
        sc=-1 if nc<=ctc else 1
        reloc[(r,c)]=(nr,nc); 
        rr,rc=nr,nc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=rc<W and out[rr][rc]!=2:
            out[rr][rc]=v
            if (rr,rc)!=(nr,nc) and out[rr][rc]!=v: break
            rr+=sr; rc+=sc
    # erode: cleared original cells
    return out,reloc
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']; out,_=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])
    d=sum(o[r][c]!=out[r][c] for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])))
    print(p,d)

def solve(i):
    H=len(i); W=len(i[0])
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if i[r][c]==2 and i[r][c+1]==2 and i[r+1][c]==2 and i[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for br,bc in blocks:
        for r in range(br,br+2):
            for c in range(bc,bc+2): out[r][c]=2
    moves=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=i[r][c]
            if v in (0,2): continue
            best=None
            for br,bc in blocks:
                d=min(abs(br-r)+abs(bc-c),abs(br+1-r)+abs(bc-c),abs(br-r)+abs(bc+1-c),abs(br+1-r)+abs(bc+1-c))
                if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,(br,bc))
            br,bc=best[1]
            ctr,ctc=br+0.5,bc+0.5
            n=(int(round(ctr+(c-ctc))), int(round(ctc-(r-ctr))))
            sr=-1 if n[0]<=ctr else 1
            sc=-1 if n[1]<=ctc else 1
            moves.append((r,c,v,n,sr,sc))
    for r,c,v,n,sr,sc in moves: out[n[0]][n[1]]=v
    # ray extends from target AWAY from original (sgn*sr/sc away) until nonzero, overwriting nothing except zeros
    for r,c,v,n,sr,sc in moves:
        rr,rc=n
        while True:
            rr+=sr; rc+=sc
            if not(0<=rr<H) or not(0<=rc<W) or out[rr][rc]!=0: break
            out[rr][rc]=v
    return out
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']; g=solve(G[f'Demo pair {p} input'])
    print('demo',p,'diff:',sum(o[r][c]!=g[r][c] for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0]))))

def solve(i):
    H=len(i); W=len(i[0])
    blocks=[(r,c) for r in range(H-1) for c in range(W-1) if i[r][c]==2 and i[r][c+1]==2 and i[r+1][c]==2 and i[r+1][c+1]==2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for br,bc in blocks:
        for r in range(br,br+2):
            for c in range(bc,bc+2): out[r][c]=2
    moves=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=i[r][c]
            if v in (0,2): continue
            best=None
            for br,bc in blocks:
                d=min(abs(br-r)+abs(bc-c),abs(br+1-r)+abs(bc-c),abs(br-r)+abs(bc+1-c),abs(br+1-r)+abs(bc+1-c))
                if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,(br,bc))
            br,bc=best[1]
            ctr,ctc=br+0.5,bc+0.5
            n=(int(round(ctr+(c-ctc))), int(round(ctc-(r-ctr))))
            sr=-1 if n[0]<=ctr else 1
            sc=-1 if n[1]<=ctc else 1
            moves.append((r,c,v,n,sr,sc))
    for r,c,v,n,sr,sc in moves: out[n[0]][n[1]]=v
    # rays from original position along (sr,sc) direction ONLY, stopping at nonzero (targets already painted)
    for r,c,v,n,sr,sc in moves:
        rr,rc=r
        while True:
            rr+=sr; rc+=sc
            if not(0<=rr<H) or not(0<=rc<W) or out[rr][rc]!=0: break
            out[rr][rc]=v
    return out

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
